text:
ellie (ml): heads-up: spectra13b int4 onboard flapping under long-chat traffic. pattern: OOMs after ~9-11k session tokens, steady-state.
sam (infra): can you paste repro config? microbatch size and prefetch mode?
ellie (ml): repro below. happens reliably when history depth grows.
```
model=spectra13b
quant=int4
batch=6
max_new_tokens=1024
prefetch=aggressive
```
drew (runtime): that combo increases KV churn. int4 shrinks tensors but magnifies allocation frequency for prefetch pages and KV lines -> freelist fragmentation.
tara (prodex): we should avoid changing UX too much. propose canary with conservative defaults and a short A/B for quality.
sam (infra): plan: push canary to 2 hosts with prefetch=lazy, batch=3, max_new_tokens=512, kv_eviction_threshold=0.72. also enable slot_compactor (qos=low). deploy-bot: rolling canary -> nodes gpu-412,gpu-415 (tag: canary/spectra13b/2026-03-24).
ellie (ml): starting long-context eval (250 sessions, avg 10k history). baseline: p95=460ms, rss_peak=24.0GB, failure_rate=1.1%.
drew (runtime): also flip kv_prefetch_shrink=true and set reserve_ratio=0.04 to keep small contiguous reserve for big allocations. add session-level prefetch-skip if session_tokens>4k.
sam (infra): applied runtime flags to canary. added freelist_fragmentation_pct to dashboards.
ellie (ml): 1h snapshot: canary failure_rate=0.12%, p95 +28ms, rss -350MB, freelist_fragmentation_pct down from 20%->7%.
tara (prodex): quality delta? int4-only vs int8 fallback? need EM numbers for our QA set.
ellie (ml): quick A/B: int4-only -0.6% EM; with int8-fallback above 18k session tokens it's -0.12% EM. acceptable by our threshold.
drew (runtime): recommendation: change hosted defaults for spectra13b/int4 -> prefetch=lazy, default_batch=3, max_new_tokens=512, kv_eviction_threshold=0.75, kv_prefetch_shrink=true, reserve_ratio=0.04, compactor.qos=low. add auto-fallback to int8 at session_tokens>18k and session_eviction_backoff if eviction_count>3 in 5m.
sam (infra): will gate the default change behind feature-flag and run 24h canary. adding kernel_colocation probe in telemetry to detect big-kernel hotspots.
tara (prodex): I'll draft release notes: "spectra13b int4 defaults tuned for long-dialog stability; for higher token budgets use Dedicated or reserved nodes." add console tooltip.
ellie (ml): ML action: export full eval CSV after 24h and check EM/regression thresholds. revert plan if EM delta >1%.
ops-bot: canary alarm: 0 OOMs in last 90m on canary hosts.
drew (runtime): small follow-up: if customers pin max_new_tokens >1k, route them to dedicated or apply per-cust soft quota. we should also instrument a per-session compaction hint to proactively compact slots for sessions with predicted long tails.
sam (infra): added per-customer routing rule to staging.
ellie (ml): thanks everyone. TL;DR: root cause = aggressive prefetch + int4 + deep KV chains; mitigations (lazy prefetch, lower defaults, slot compactor, reserve, int8 fallback) look effective in canary. will report 24h export. :thumbsup:
